eventBrief.title: What are you promoting?
eventBrief.description: Describe the event, launch or campaign. Include the product or experience and the kind of creator you need.
eventBrief.default: A weekend vintage-fashion pop-up featuring independent sellers, styling sessions and sustainable fashion.
eventBrief.prefill: A weekend vintage-fashion pop-up featuring independent sellers, styling sessions and sustainable fashion.

city.title: City
city.description: City that must be explicitly mentioned in supporting creator captions. This is local-content evidence, not verified audience location.

audience.title: Intended audience
audience.description: Your target audience; the agent does not infer or verify creators’ audience demographics.
audience.default: People interested in vintage fashion and independent brands
audience.prefill: People interested in vintage fashion and independent brands

objective.title: Campaign objective
objective.description: What should the proposed collaboration encourage? Attendance, awareness or another clear action.
objective.default: Drive awareness and visits to the pop-up
objective.prefill: Drive awareness and visits to the pop-up

venue.title: Venue (optional)
venue.description: Venue name for Google Maps context. Leave empty for the agent to research a relevant venue category.

lookbackDays.title: Evidence lookback (days)
lookbackDays.description: Only dated social posts in this window can support recommendations. One snapshot cannot establish growth.

instagramHashtag.title: Instagram research hashtag (optional)
instagramHashtag.description: Optional seed without # or spaces. Leave empty for the agent to choose from your brief.

tiktokSearch.title: TikTok search (optional)
tiktokSearch.description: Optional initial query. Leave empty for the agent to choose. One evidence-driven follow-up is allowed.
